name: telegram
description: Your own Telegram account, a real user, not a bot: login, chats, messages, groups, bans, voice calls and voice messages. Received files are saved in /home/bia/files/inbox/telegram/; voice notes arrive transcribed as [speech <lang>]; locations, contacts and edits arrive as [location], [live location], [contact] and [edited <id>] lines.
examples: root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|log into telegram with +420… -> discover(path='mcp/telegram', enable=true); telegram_login(phone='+420…')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|send hi on that telegram chat -> telegram_send(chat_id='123', text='hi')
alice|telegram:123|<issued>|<delivered>|[incoming call] from alice -> telegram_call_accept(chat_id='123') or telegram_call_reject(chat_id='123')

alice|telegram:123|<issued>|<delivered>|[speech en] hello -> say(identity='alice', channel='telegram:123', message='Hi — short spoken reply.', lang='en'); wait for [you finished speaking] before speaking again
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|send alice a voice message saying I am late -> telegram_send_voice(chat_id='123', text='Hi, I am running about ten minutes late.', lang='en')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|make a telegram group Family with @mom and @dad -> telegram_create_group(title='Family', members=['@mom', '@dad'])
